title: The AI Talent Britain Fought to Hire May Be Recalculating Its Future
summary: A proposed overhaul of UK settlement rules would double the wait for permanent residence, and it reaches back to sponsored engineers already here. For AI employers, it is quietly becoming a retention problem. By Sunny Sandhu, Senior Immigration Associate, AY&J Solicitors For year
reason: Reports a proposed UK government overhaul of settlement/immigration rules — regulatory action by an official body — framed around its impact on AI employers and talent retention, linking to reputable coverage.
